title: MenuMerchantStatus

merchant_id.description: The partner resource ID of the merchant whose specific menu ingestion job this status applies to.

status.description:
Represents the current state of the menu ingestion job.
  • `REQUESTED` - The ingestion process has been received, but it has not begun processing. Replaces `QUEUED`, but that status is not deprecated.
  • `QUEUED` - Waiting to process.
  • `IN_PROGRESS` - Job is in progress, possibly in retry cycle.
  • `SUCCESS` - Menu successfully updated.
  • `PARTIAL_SUCCESS` - Some portion of the menu has updated successfully, but not all.
  • `FAILED` - Menu could not be updated.
  • `FAILED_MENU_DOWNLOAD` - Menu request payload/URL could not be downloaded.
  • `FAILED_VALIDATION` - Menu request payload/URL could not be validated.
  • `UNKNOWN` - The ingestion process is in an unknown state. Contact support.

menu_proof_url.description: The proof URL to view the ingested menu on the front-end. This is only returned when the menu ingestion is successful.

details.description: A list where each element is a human-readable description of the status of this job or the problem encountered, if any. For example: ["Control details: jobId is ...", "Other details"], ["Error message"]

items.description: A list where each element is a human-readable description of the status of this job or the problem encountered, if any. For example: ["Control details: jobId is ...", "Other details"], ["Error message"]

media_processing_status.description: Status reflecting the state of the media uploads.

media_validation_error_list.description: A List of any media validation errors that occurred during ingestion.

tax_category_validation_errors.description: List of tax category validation errors on supplied menu.

weighted_items_validation_errors.description: String of comma-delimited items that were marked as invalid weighted items. Will not be ingested.

description: The current state or result of a menu ingestion job. Each status will be communicated with both a standardized status string and a human-readable description.

code.description: The invalid tax category code found in the menu.

errror_message.description: The error message includes more details.

InvalidCodeAndEntityIds.description: A tax category validation error found on supplied menu

entity_id.description: The entity id of the item with media validation error.

external_id.description: The external id of the item with media validation error.

MediaValidationErrorDTO.description: A media validation error that occurred during ingestion.
